```{r}
# importing libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(viridis)

```

```{r}
shp <- st_read("data/processed_grid/processed_grid.shp")
names(shp)
```

```{r}
# make maps!
n_fires_plt <- shp %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=n_wldfr)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.01, color="black") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno", transform="log", na.value="black") +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
        fill="Number of wildfires\n(log transformed)",
        title="Number of wildfires per grid cell"
    )

n_fires_plt

ggsave("maps/log_n_fires.jpeg", n_fires_plt, height=4, width=7, units="in")

shp %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=n_wldfr, alpha=is_ndgn)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.01) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno", transform="log", na.value="black") +
    scale_alpha_binned(range=c(0.6, 1)) +
    theme_void()

max_acres_plt <- shp %>%
    mutate(max_crs = as.numeric(max_crs)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=max_crs)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.01) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno") +
    theme_void()

max_acres_plt

shp %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, alpha=totl_sm, ))
```
